sources.snippet: We here provide a simple codebase to fine-tune our Depth Anything V2 pre-trained encoder for metric depth estimation. Built on our powerful encoder, we use a simple DPT head to regress the depth. We fine-tune our pre-trained encoder on synthetic Hypersim / Virtual KITTI datasets for indoor / outdoor metric depth estimation, respectively.
